abyss_flash.notes: Painterly teal-black radial burst with a bright pale core; no people, text or cropping. Reads as a flash at 32 px thanks to the single bright centre and strong dark-to-light contrast. Deep-sea teal separates it from fire and earth. Slightly softer and more airbrushed than the impasto frost_shard, and the anglerfish lure is implied rather than shown. Optional polish: add 10-15 percent sharpening or local contrast on the rays. No shipped abyss_flash icon found under public/assets/img/icons, so it beats a placeholder.
